card.name: Urgency: time is of the essence
card.fires_on: Words just before a statement about time pressure, such as 'time is of the essence', 'every second counts', 'within ninety minutes' or 'should not delay treatment'. Seen in urgent-care and emergency settings.

modes.label: Time-critical phrasing
modes.description: The word right before 'is of the essence' or 'every second counts'.
modes.example: In a trauma situation,<< time>> is of the essence.

modes.label: Linking word before a time limit
modes.description: A small word such as within, when or because that leads into a time window for treatment.
modes.example: The acute treatment of a heart attack has been shown to be best when the heart attack can be stopped<< within>> ninety minutes by opening the blood vessel to

modes.label: Not delaying treatment
modes.description: Words like delay or without that stress acting without holding up care.
modes.example: should not<< delay>> treatment with CYANOKIT, collecting

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word is 'time' (in several languages), pointing to a time-related continuation.
card.plain: It fires on words that lead into a point about how urgent the timing of treatment is.
